{{Quote|Sure, here you go. One round Fulstar plate.|Rebel supply room technician to [[C-3PO]]|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures in Colors and Shapes">''[[Star Wars Adventures in Colors and Shapes]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rebel supply room technician''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked in the supply room of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base some time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The technician once helped [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] when the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] needed a [[Fulstar plate]] to allow [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to repair the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''. The technician gave C-3PO a blue, circular Fulstar plate, but both were unaware it was not the specific kind of plate the ''Falcon'' needed.
